mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson ( date, start_time, end_time, fee, status, notes, location, max_students, actual_students, subject_id, grade_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{date}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{fee}, #{status}, #{notes}, #{location}, #{maxStudents}, #{actualStudents}, #{subjectId}, #{gradeId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_student WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT s.* FROM student s INNER JOIN lesson_student ls ON s.id = ls.student_id WHERE ls.lesson_id = #{lessonId}
SELECT l.* FROM lesson l INNER JOIN lesson_student ls ON l.id = ls.lesson_id WHERE ls.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY l.date DESC, l.start_time ASC
